reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 3 THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_revenue_eur), 1) AS bulk_revenue_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY country_code
